1a_databases_or_schemas.recommendation: one cluster, three databases: mainboard (control, ducklake_<LakeId>), aizk (AIZK public, unchanged), logto; roles cannot cross databases; aizk_admin not a superuser
evidence: AIZK hard-codes public in Alembic, 42 policies, pgrls.toml and search_path
pg_dump exported snapshots cannot span databases and AIZK's largest COPY takes 35 s
DuckLake METADATA_SCHEMA works in a database shared with other schemas (measured, 30 catalog tables, 2.3 ms commits)

1b_extensions.recommendation: tier 1 extension-free (pgvector HNSW plus application-tokenized text search and pg_trgm) gated by the golden set; tier 2 source-built VectorChord stack in an extension_control_path directory; tier 3 keep the aizk database on Linux

upstream.VectorChord: 1.1.1 (2026-02-28), deb and zip for linux amd64 and arm64, PostgreSQL 14 to 18, no macOS asset, build with cargo-pgrx 0.17.0, AGPLv3 or ELv2

measured.pgvector_via_extension_control_path: loaded from a directory outside the environment (create extension vector -> 0.8.6)
measured.japanese_simple_tsvector: one or two tokens per sentence

1c_backups_pooling_upgrades.recommendation: native tools: pg_basebackup incremental, WAL archive, per-database pg_dump, globals, offsite to crimson /mnt/ssd2 and PORTABLE; no external pooler; minor upgrades by restart on a retained binary generation, major by dump and restore
evidence: pg_combinebackup and pg_walsummary in the environment
restore of 346 MiB dump 117.7 s tuned, 192.8 s default

2_placement.recommendation: center Mac mini hosts PostgreSQL and AIZK's whole application tier; crimson keeps the stopped stack for rollback, then becomes the backup target

options.B_db_on_center_app_on_crimson: rejected: +0.1 s find, +0.24 s keep (+85%), worker 1.3 statements per second over the jump
options.C_db_on_crimson: rejected: advisory-lock ownership and DuckLake commits across the jump host

3_data_split.recommendation: PostgreSQL keeps all transactional data; DuckLake gets memory_usage (mirror), memory_events (logs) and evaluation receipts; blobs to a content-addressed directory

4_slimming_and_ram.recommendation: drop Docling, GLiNER, SeaweedFS, observability (5), ClamAV by default, vLLM lanes; hosted embeddings and reranking behind the golden set

5_packaging.recommendation: separate package and repository; mainboard owns the shared server, service rendering and a thin mb memory front mounting aizk.client behind mainboard[memory]; revisit a merge on measured triggers

options.mainboard_serve_extra_containing_aizk: rejected: heavy dependencies into the package shipped to every host
options.merged_repository: rejected: breaks AIZK's public identity and release cadence

5_packaging.naming: mb memory (mb serve collides with mainboard host serve and the lake serve verb)
